thread:
liam: Quick sync request — we need to lock acceptance gates for the next catalog intake. thinking: small canary + staged ramp, but tradeoffs around bench vs. rollout speed. any objections?
sara: +1 on staged ramp. need explicit cost cap per cohort though.
noah: agree. also want concrete bench set (100 prompt samples?) and p95 latency thresholds.
liam: proposed bench: 120 prompts (20 convo, 60 single-turn, 40 edge cases). p95 < 250ms for host tier, < 400ms for dedicated. cost delta < 20% vs baseline.
maya: for evals we should include hallucination checks and embedding drift spot-checks. add 15 prompts for hallucination.
sara: can we auto-fail if hallucination rate > 3% on those checks?
noah: auto-fail is fine but we should allow a one-time remediation window (48h) before full reject.
rachel: customers will push for faster cutover. can we define a fast-track: larger canary (10% traffic) + stricter rollback hooks?
liam: fast-track sounds ok for enterprise customers with signed SLA. requires: signed rollback plan, 24/7 on-call, and post-deploy eval runbook.
ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: Canary group created (10% traffic) -> route: eu-west, us-east.
noah: can we codify the rollout policy as three knobs: canary_size, ramp_steps, bump_delay? sample: {canary_size:5%, ramp_steps:[5%,15%,50%], bump_delay:30m}
sara: bump_delay should be min 15m for low-risk models, 1h for large memory ones.
maya: we need to record bench inputs and random seed for reproducibility. add a unique eval-id to every run.
liam: acceptance criteria draft: (1) bench coverage >= 120 prompts + hallucination checks, (2) p95 latency within target, (3) perf delta <=20%, (4) post-canary quality delta <=2% on key metrics, (5) security scan pass, (6) remediation window used at most once.
rachel: add customer opt-in checkbox for fast-track + explicit billing acknowledgement.
noah: operationally, add automatic fallback: if error rate > 1% or p95 > 2x target for 2 consecutive windows, route traffic to pinned stable variant.
liam: agreed. assigned actions: noah -> update rollout config schema; maya -> add hallucination prompts to bench repo; sara -> define cost cap calc; rachel -> fast-track billing template. target PRs by EOD Thursday.
sara: noted, will model cost cap w/ 95th percentile traffic assumptions.
maya: I'll add eval-id and seed to CI and push sample set.
noah: I'll bake rollout knobs into runtime and add a validation step in deploy CI.
liam: thanks all. we'll reconvene after PRs. if anything blocks fast-track, flag with `#catalog-priority` and ping me. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: note: scheduled maintenance in us-east at 1742107000 — may affect canary windows.
sara: thanks — we'll avoid major ramps during that window.
liam: closing thread for now, will post final acceptance doc when PRs are merged.
